address.label: Address
address.description: MQTT server address to use for default/custom servers

username.label: Username
username.description: MQTT username to use for default/custom servers

password.label: Password
password.description: MQTT password to use for default/custom servers

encryptionEnabled.label: Encryption Enabled
encryptionEnabled.description: Enable or disable MQTT encryption. Note: All messages are sent to the MQTT broker unencrypted if this option is not enabled, even when your uplink channels have encryption keys set. This includes position data.

jsonEnabled.label: JSON output enabled
jsonEnabled.description: Whether to send/consume JSON packets on MQTT

root.label: Root Topic
root.description: MQTT root topic to use for default/custom servers

proxyToClientEnabled.label: MQTT Client Proxy
proxyToClientEnabled.description: Utilizes the network connection to proxy MQTT messages to the client.

mapReportingEnabled.label: Map Reporting
mapReportingEnabled.description: Your node will periodically send an unencrypted map report packet to the configured MQTT server, this includes id, short and long name, approximate location, hardware model, role, firmware version, LoRa region, modem preset and primary channel name.

publishIntervalSecs.label: Map Report Publish Interval (s)
publishIntervalSecs.description: Interval in seconds to publish map reports

positionPrecision.label: Approximate Location
positionPrecision.description: Position shared will be accurate within this distance

shouldReportLocation.label: I agree.
shouldReportLocation.description: I have read and understand the above. I voluntarily consent to the unencrypted transmission of my node data via MQTT.
shouldReportLocation.consentHeader: Consent to Share Unencrypted Node Data via MQTT
shouldReportLocation.consentText: By enabling this feature, you acknowledge and expressly consent to the transmission of your device's real-time geographic location over the MQTT protocol without encryption. This location data may be used for purposes such as live map reporting, device tracking, and related telemetry functions.

bleThreshold.description: At what BLE RSSI level should the counter increase. Defaults to -80.

meshBeacon.title: Mesh Beacon
meshBeacon.description: Hear and send invitations that let nearby radios join a channel
meshBeacon.regionRequired: Set your radio's region before setting up a beacon.
meshBeacon.requiresPreset: Beacon broadcasting advertises a modem preset for others to join. This radio uses custom LoRa settings instead of a standard preset, so a beacon could invite people onto settings they cannot hear. Broadcasting can be turned off here, but not on, until the radio uses a standard modem preset.

region.label: Region
region.description: The beacon always advertises this radio's region and preset

listenEnabled.label: Listen for beacons
listenEnabled.description: Receive beacons from other nodes. Their text goes to your messages, and their channel offers appear on the Channels page

broadcastEnabled.label: Broadcast a beacon
broadcastEnabled.description: Periodically advertise this mesh to nearby nodes

broadcastMessage.label: Message
broadcastMessage.description: Text sent with each beacon, up to 100 bytes

broadcastIntervalSecs.label: Broadcast interval
broadcastIntervalSecs.description: How often to send a beacon. The minimum is one hour

offerChannel.groupDescription: The channel the beacon invites nearby radios to join
offerChannel.label: Offered channel
offerChannel.description: Channel whose name and key the beacon offers to listeners

targets.label: Broadcast targets
targets.description: Where each beacon is sent. Default uses the radio's running preset and channel
